In this petition, petitioners have sought for the following reliefs:-
"Wherefore, the Petitioners respectfully prays that this Hon'ble court may be
pleased to -
a] Call for the records in respect of Crime.No.157/2023 pending on the file of 7th
Addl. Civil Judge(Jr. Dn) & Jmfc Court, Mysuru;
b] Quash the Fir culminated in Crime.No.157/2023 registered registered by the
Respondent No. 1 / womens police mysore urban for the offences punishable under
Section 498A, 324 and 34 of I.P.C. read with Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition
Act, pending on the file of 7th Addl. Civil Judge(Jr. Dn) & Jmfc Court, Mysuru,
under the facts and circumstances of the case; and c] Pass any other appropriate
order or orders or direction as this Hon'ble court may deems fit to grant by
considering the facts and circumstance of the case, in the interests of justice and
equity."
Nc: 2025:Khc:19618 Hc-Kar

"Considering that the matter arises out of matrimonial dispute and at the request of the learned counsel appearing for both the parties, this matter is referred to Mediation Centre, Mysuru.
Parties are permitted to appear before the Mediation Centre, Mysuru on 17.05.2025.
List this petition on 09.06.2025.

Interim order is extended till next date of hearing."

sentences.text:
This petition is pled by the petitioner under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing the FIR in Cr.No.157/2023 on the file of the 7th Addl Civil Judge (Jr.Dn.) and JMFC Court at Mysuru against the Respondent No.1 and 2.
ii.
Both the complainant and accused viz., the present petitioner 1 and 2 and their respective counsels along with the parties of the complaint have participated in the Mediation Proceedings.
iii. Mediation proceedings held and discussed elaborately.

iv. Both the parties are unable to live together henceforth and out of their own free will volition and without any sort of coercion and pressure both the parties have agreed to settle the above matter as per the condition and terms mentioned herein below voluntarily viz.,
1) The petitioner in the above petition undertaken and agree to pay to the Respondent No.2 a sum of Rs.21 Lakhs (Twenty one Lakhs) only as permanent alimony for which the Respondent No.2 undertaken and agree to receive the same.
2) Out of the above marriage there is no issues between the petitioner and Respondent No.2 NC:
2025:KHC:19618 HC-KAR 3) The petitioner undertaken and agree to pay fifty percent of the above said viz. Ten Lakh Fifty Thousand only before the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka at Bangalore on the hearing date i.e.
09.06.2025 to the Respondent No.2.
4) Both the parties undertake and agree to move the Joint Petition for Divorce before the competent Authority at Mysuru and on the date of filing the above Joint Petition the petitioner undertaken and agree to pay the balance amount of Rs.Ten Lakh Fifty Thousand to the Respondent No.2.

5) That the Respondent No.2 undertaken and agree to withdraw the Crl.Misc.25/2024 on the file of II Addl. Principal Family Court at Mysuru after filing the Joint Petition for Divorce after receiving the balance amount from the petitioner.
